name: Geometry-adaptive Lp + NSGA-III
tagline: For 2 objectives, iteratively eliminate the most crowded individual under an Lp distance whose exponent p tracks the front geometry; for 3+ objectives fall back to NSGA-III reference points; maintain an extreme-point archive.

key_hyperparams.name: p_geo
key_hyperparams.role: Lp distance exponent adapted to front shape

key_hyperparams.name: archive size
key_hyperparams.role: extreme non-dominated solutions kept across generations

init_recovers: NSGA-II survival when p=2 and archive is empty
diff_from_baseline: Replaces NSGA-II crowding in 2-obj problems with iterative Lp-NN elimination using a front-geometry-estimated exponent p plus an extreme-point archive; switches to selNSGA3 for 3+ objectives.

name: Adaptive APD + DE/SBX hybrid
tagline: RVEA-style angle-penalised distance survival with adaptive reference vectors and ideal/nadir tracking for ≥3 objectives, NSGA-II crowding for 2, plus a one-third DE / two-thirds SBX variation step and a periodic archive injection.
diff_from_baseline: Adds RVEA-style adaptive APD survival, DE/SBX hybrid variation, ideal/nadir-normalised reference vectors that rescale with front extent, and an archive that periodically reinjects elites.

name: SDE truncation + DE/SBX hybrid
tagline: NSGA-II for 2 objectives, but for 3+ replace crowding with shift-based density (SDE) computed from clipped pairwise differences; vary by random DE/rand/1 vs SBX flip per child plus polynomial mutation.

key_hyperparams.name: DE/SBX prob
key_hyperparams.role: per-child split between DE/rand/1 and SBX

diff_from_baseline: Replaces NSGA-II crowding with shift-based density estimation for 3+ objectives and adds a stochastic DE/rand/1 variation branch that fires with probability 0.5 per child.

name: ARC-MOEA (rarity + crowding + niching)
tagline: Reference-direction-niched MOEA with tournament keys (rank, rarity, crowding, angle), centroid-pull recombination toward sparse niche leaders, and adaptive splitting-front truncation balancing rarity, diversity, convergence and angle.
init_recovers: NSGA-II tournament + crowding when rarity weights → 0 and dir_prob → 0
diff_from_baseline: Adds reference-vector niching (rarity), centroid-pull directional recombination toward niche leaders, and an adaptive splitting-front truncation score that interpolates between convergence and diversity over generations.
